lastCompletedStory.title: Doc + dead-code cleanup for round-3 WARNING and three suggestions

nextStoryContext: US-009 was a doc + dead-code cleanup story. Four changes: (1) recovery-runbook.md Option B rewritten to point at the real maxRounds sources (prd.review.maxRounds JSON field and CAM_MAX_REVIEW_ROUNDS env var) since no code reads [review] max_rounds from project.toml; (2) recovery-runbook.md Resend escalation grep diagnostic clarified to say it shows only FAILED escalations (sendEscalation writes stderr only on failure; success is silent); (3) src/commands/setup.ts: removed dead --resend-api-key flag (two parse arms, resendApiKey field from SetupOptions and ParsedSetupArgs, and the :605 fallback) - warnIfResendUnconfigured now reads RESEND_API_KEY env var only; (4) scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md Stop Condition: added note that requires:operator stories are hand-filed only (US-003 removed planner emission). New test in setup.test.ts confirms env-var-only path still fires the loud warning. All 1892 tests pass.
